overview: The core text component for paragraph and running copy. Use it for body content, descriptions, and any standard reading text throughout your product.

whenToUse: For paragraph and body copy throughout the UI — prose descriptions, instructions, and supporting text
When you need inline text emphasis such as bold, italic, or strikethrough within a passage
When you need a highlighted callout inline within body copy to draw attention to a key term
do: Use size 1 for primary body copy and size 2 for supporting or secondary text at a smaller visual weight
Use the highlight prop sparingly — one or two key terms per passage — so it retains its attention-drawing effect
Use the type prop (bold, italic, strikethrough) rather than raw HTML tags to ensure consistent token-based styling
dont: Don't use body text for section or page titles — use the Headings component instead
Don't apply strikethrough for decorative purposes; reserve it for content that is explicitly deleted or no longer valid
Don't stack multiple highlight colors in the same paragraph — it creates visual noise and dilutes emphasis
